text: Lieutenant Drex is a Forsaken quest giver located in the Shattered Strand of Azshara. Captain Desoto has players report to him from Bilgewater Harbor. He appears to be one of the few non-goblin members of the Bilgewater Battalion. Like other members, he is tagged with the Bilgewater Cartel faction. Following players' work for him, he will send them to Captain Tork in the Ruins of Eldarath at the request of Commander Molotov. During the Demon Invasions, he defended the area.
Lieutenant Paulson is a quest giver located in the Deep Reaches of Stonetalon Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Lieutenant Morra Starbreeze is a night elf quest giver in Darkshore. Her area's quests are triggered by the quest The Shatterspear Invaders.
Life Cocoon is a Mistweaver monk ability, encasing the player in a cocoon of Chi energy for 12 seconds, absorbing a certain amount of damage based on the monk's total Health and Versatility.
Lift-Off is an ability used by most birds during a Pet Battle.
Life Exchange is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Light's Fall is a ruin located south of Embaari Village in . It is here that sought to absorb the power of the , and gave his life to prevent it.
__NOTOC__ Lieutenant Strathmar is a nightborne located in Suramar City.
Light-Armored Elekks are elekks located in Shadowmoon Valley.
Light's Reckoning is a passive racial ability for all lightforged draenei, avenging their deaths, with damage dealt to all nearby enemies, and healing done to nearby allies, within 8 yards.

Light's Purchase is one of the camps of the Army of the Light in the Antoran Wastes. It is found in the south-eastern corner of the zone. This location may be destroyed. It alternates daily with the Veiled Den.
Lifting Specialist Gogo is a hobgoblin located on Mechagon Island.
Life-Tender Olvarius is a keeper of the grove located in the Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Life Barrier is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Light-Infused Egg is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Light-Bearers were an order of beings from the planet Fanlin'Deskor. Ta'lora mentions them alongside the paladins of Azeroth as an example of mortals who dedicated themselves to service and duty in life and whose souls were consequently sent to Bastion after death.

__NOTOC__ Lightning Eel is obtained by fishing in the waters around Karazhan in Deadwind Pass, at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring, in the river that seprates Western Plaguelands and Eastern Plaguelands, in Bloodvenom Falls in Felwood, in the Verdantis River and top of the The Twin Colossals in Feralas, within Zul'Gurub, in the Western Plaguelands, off the shores of Isle of Quel'Danas, and also found in rivers & Lake Elune'ara of Moonglade. Used as a quest item for Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel to obtain an Insignia of the Crusade or Insignia of the Dawn and +75 Argent Dawn rep.
Lightning Breath is a Hunter pet ability specific to the Wind Serpent family.

__NOTOC__ Light of Dawn is a Holy paladin talent. The ability sends a cone of light in front of the paladin, healing up to 5 of the lowest health party/raid members in a 15 yard area in front of the caster.
The Lightbearer is found at leaning up against a tree near a wall west of Terokkar Refuge on Duskfall Island in east-central Talador. Loot it to acquire the Lightbearer item.
Light of the Protector is a level 12 Protection paladin ability.
Light of T'uure is a Holy priest ability, learned as an artifact trait from T'uure, Beacon of the Naaru. It is linked to the Serenity Now trait.
Light of the Evening Star is a Balance druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Radiance of the Cenarion Circle and Wax and Wane traits.

Lightforged Warframes are Lightforged draenei in warframes located on Krokuun. One is used during Dawn of Justice and Holding the Spire to assault the Court of the Avenger in Nath'raxas Hold and available as a zone ability for Argus.
__NOTOC__ Lightforged Warpriests are Lightforged draenei located at Destiny Point and in the Shattered Fields on Krokuun. They also appear in Antoran Wastes and Eredath.
Lightly Roasted Artifact Power was a quest reward from Lightly Roasted on the PTR.
Lightforged Beacon: Shattered Fields is a quest reward from Light's Return.

Lightforged Beacon: The Veiled Den is a quest reward from Reinforce the Veiled Den. Note that this location is NOT always active. If it has been destroyed, and Light's Purchase is active, it should be back the following day.
Lightforged beacons are teleportation devices used by the Army of the Light on Argus. After the Argus Campaign, the beacons have become a part of the Alliance.
Lightforged Sunshields are Lightforged draenei located at the Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City. They can also be found at various locations in Ironforge and in the Exodar.
The Lightless Cavern is the cavern that leads to the Primordial Observatory. It is near a massive sunken titan city similar to the Terrace of the Makers.
Lightly-Padded Cage Helm drops from the Death Metal Knight during the Blight Boar concert every hour 30 minutes past the hour at the Darkmoon Faire.
The Lightlock will appear over a bridge of "Arcane Lava" in the Court of Stars. The disc will allow passage as a part of the Riddle of the Hivemind.

Light-Step Hoofplates are equipped in the Mount Equipment slot of a character's Mount Collection. Though the slot is account-wide, equipment must be added for each character played. The effect is to increase your mount's ground speed by 20%. It does not work in Battlegrounds or Arena and it does not stack with other mount speed effects. For example: * Guild Perk Mount Up - increases speed while mounted by 10%. Not active in Battlegrounds or Arenas. * Battle for Azeroth: Pathfinder - increases mounted movement speed in Zandalar and Kul Tiras by 20% and allows flying. * Monel-Hardened Hoofplates - increases mounted movement speed in Zandalar and Kul Tiras by 20% for 2 hours (4 hours for Blacks

Lightning Orbs are sparks that appear during Infuriating the Emperor when Vorrik's Bulwark kills the Faithless sethrak in Skycallers' Spire and the Sacred Sands in Vol'dun. Running over them refills the power of the Bulwark.
Lightforged Representatives are Lightforged draenei located in Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.
Lightning Dust is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Light-Tinged Scraps is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lightfire Soles is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lightblade Haft is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Light Readings are flying tomess located in Ardenweald.
Lightning Thieves are air elementals located throughout Valdrakken, while the Arcane Forge is being empowered. They will attempt to steal energy sources gathered for the forge.

Lil Timmy is a kitten vendor located in Stormwind City. He is a little human boy that rarely spawns, and wanders along the canals and through Cathedral Square before disappearing again. He can sell an Alliance player a White Kitten, but only ever carries one in stock when he spawns.
__NOTOC__ Limited Invulnerability Potion is a potion that reduces physical damage taken.

Lilliam Sparkspindle is a gnome artisan engineering trainer located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by the Horde champions at Deep Elem Mine in Silverpine Forest. He appears in the Vision of Stormwind.

__NOTOC__ Lilyssia Nightbreeze is a night elf artisan alchemy trainer located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. She is the resident trainer in the alchemy shop Alchemy Needs in the eastern section of the Mage Quarter, where she shares her knowledge with those looking to increase their skill in the delicate profession of alchemy. One such student is the nearby alchemist-in-training Tel'Athir.

Line of sight, commonly abbreviated LOS, is an unobstructed line drawn from your character to an enemy. Most abilities or spells and ranged attacks require that you have line of sight to your target to cast them, and will give a message when you don't, canceling the activation. When casting a channeled spell on an aggroed enemy, when that enemy moves in such a way as to block your LOS at any point in that cast, it will cancel your spell. For example, if you are on the ground, and you begin casting Smite or any such spell on a melee mob that is in an elevated shack, when that mob comes at you, he will cross behind pillars, most likely, and at that point your cast will be canceled. (For those

__NOTOC__ Lillith Nefara is a wraith and powerful Scourge agent that spawns upon completing The Dormant Shade at Lillith's Dinner Table, found on an islet next to Gunther's Retreat on Brightwater Lake in Tirisfal Glades. Gunther Arcanus wants Lillith killed.
Lindsay Ashlock is a human general goods vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.

icon.]] A shadow in the night, the lightslayer moves with the sound of a whisper to extinguish light wherever she finds it — specifically, she extinguishes the followers of the Holy Light. The lightslayer embraces the teachings of the Forgotten Shadow and develops her personal power by slaying enemies who stand in the light. Some consider lightslayers the dark mirror of the Scarlet Crusade, but in truth the two organizations have little in common. The Scarlet Crusade possesses a firm hierarchy; their fanaticism is orderly and focused. Lightslayers, on the other hand, usually work alone. They make use of stealth, hit-and-run tactics, and the element of surprise. The only strong similarity bet

Lilki, a female murloc, is an important shaman of the White Shark tribe. Though young for such a position, she is already admired for her wisdom, her power, and her fervent sacrifices. Most murlocs consider her Shlur's successor. Some whisper that Lilki not only wants the position but is unwilling to wait until her superior dies naturally.

The Limb Regeneration Bracers drop from The Prophet Tharon'ja in Drak'Tharon Keep on heroic mode. According to Muradin Bronzebeard, these mail bracers once belonged to the Prophet Tharon’ja, who certainly doesn't need them any longer, being that he was first transformed into an undead skeletal serpent who had no hands.
Lilleth Radescu is a Forsaken flight master located at the Apothecary Camp in the Howling Fjord.

Lindsey Ravensun was a Forsaken who took part in the Battle for Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. Towards the end of the conflict, she was called upon by Koltira Deathweaver to assist in the battle. She then revealed herself to Horde agents as the alter-ego of none other than Sylvanas Windrunner. As she shed her disguise, Sylvanas took over command of the battle from Koltira. There were a few hints towards the true identity of Lindsay such as her intimate knowledge of the Val'kyr and her ability to speak through them, her name being an anagram of "Sylvanas Windrunner" (though it's missing the W and one R), or her saying that "the dark lady watches over you".
Lily, Oh Lily is a daily cooking quest available from Eunice Burch in the Trade Quarter in Undercity.
Liliana Emberfrost is an Alliance heirloom vendor in Stormwind City.

Lindsay is a human master Pet Tamer located south of the bridge over Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. She is surrounded by her three level 5 battle pets, Flipsy, Dipsy, and Flufftail, as well as their numerous offspring. Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Eastern Kingdoms achievement.
Lightspring is a priest ability granted by Glyph of Lightspring. It transforms Lightwell into Lightspring.
Like an Arrow to the Face is an achievement that is awarded for defeating Garalon in the Heart of Fear raid instance without destroying any of his legs.
Linsa is a draenei tabard vendor located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
Lion's Mooncallers are night elves located at Domination Point in the Domination Point scenario.
Lio the Lioness is a worgen that runs the Menagerie in Lunarfall. She revives dead pets. She is also found in Magical Menagerie in Dalaran.

Linny "The Skinny" Leadpockets is the Horde aligned smuggler whose services adventurers acquire if they choose to construct the Smuggler's Den at Axefall in Spires of Arak. Every ten minutes, players with the Smuggling Den are able to summon her using the Smuggling Run! ability. She functions as a merchant, offering various items that offer beneficial buffs in the Spires of Arak, healing potions, and some other useful stock. Her stock is randomized, and changes each time she is summoned.
__NOTOC__ Lightsworn Vindicators are draenei found on the stairs to the Black Temple in Shadowmoon Valley.

__NOTOC__ Lightsworn Anchorites are draenei anchorites who appear during the Battle for the Exodar. They appear together with High Vindicators after the fel portals have been destroyed and war banners have been placed. Later, they were found guarding the entrance to the Exodar, praying in groups, and traveled on the Vindicaar to Argus.

__NOTOC__ Lilryia Dawnwind is a night elf located at the Crimson Thicket in Suramar. Lilryia and her friend Nighteyes left Irongrove Retreat to scout the Crimson Thicket. When Lilryia could hear Nighteyes in trouble she tried to follow him only to be caught in a magical trap. After the adventurer helps free her and rescue Nighteyes, they work together to deal with the traps and nightborne trappers in the area. Afterwards, Nighteyes continues to scout while Lilryia remains in the Thicket.
__NOTOC__ Lil'idan is a baby murloc demon hunter located in Shipwreck Cove of Highmountain.
Links of Faith were sold for by Alanaa during Island Expeditions.
Lightprisms were sold for by Alanaa during Island Expeditions.
Limited Power is a debuff that is applied to the Charging Station.
Lingering Psychic Shell drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Lingering Torments is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lingering Reverberations is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Lihuvim, Principle Architect, is the fifth boss of the Sepulcher of the First Ones. After it gets destroyed, another one is formed and replaces the defeated one.
Lion's Strength drops from Doom's Howl in the Arathi Highlands.
Lightshatter Hatchet drops from Halondrus in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Lilian's Hearthstone is provided by Lilian Voss for Return to Brill to be teleported to Brill.
__NOTOC__ Lillian Brightmoon is a night elf located in the Azure Archives Annex in Valdrakken. On the shelf next to her sits Mr. Biscuits, a small marmoni.
Lingering Wraths are arcane wraiths summoned by destroying Owlkin Totems in the Hidden Grove in Winterspring.
Lightsworn Elekk Riders are draenei located in Shadowmoon Valley.

:The helm grants the ability to strike blows as pure and true as a rich thorium vein. The Lionheart Helm was a top DPS helm for Warriors prior to the release of The Burning Crusade. However the helm was considered very material intensive, in a time when Arcanite Bars could command a substantial price.
__NOTOC__ Lisrythe Bloodwatch is a level 64 gem vendor located on the Scryer's Tier in the neutral Shattrath City.

Lirath Windrunner was the youngest brother of the Windrunner siblings. He was particularly close with the middle sister, Sylvanas. Though physically weak, he was a brilliant singer and musician and made a name for himself performing at Lord Saltheril's parties. After performing for Kael'thas at one such party, the prince was so impressed that he invited Lirath to Silvermoon's Artists' Quarter and found him an apprenticeship. Eventually, Lirath was named Royal Musician and began training other musicians. in World of Warcraft.]] Despite his love and talent for music, Lirath still found himself wishing at times that he had become a ranger like his three sisters. List of mobs with special abilities, susceptible to Mind Control.
Living Flames are fire elementals summoned by Defias Magicians in the Deadmines.

Livery Outpost is a subzone of Gilneas. It is a horse stable just outside of Gilneas City, near the bridge that leads to Merchant Square. It is also at the end of the mine cart tracks that lead from Emberstone Mine.
Little Cleankite is a grummle flight master found at One Keg in Kun-Lai Summit.
Lira Skysplitter is a tauren flight master located at Thunder Cleft in the Krasarang Wilds. Unlike the rest of the camp, she does not appear to be a member of the Dawnchaser tribe.

Little Fu is a pandaren cub whose home in Kun-Lai was destroyed by yaungol. With only his father, Buwei left, he traveled to Mistfall Village in the newly opened Vale of Eternal Blossoms. While on the way there, they met Li Li Stormstout. The only time when Fu smiled was when he was playing with her cub, Shisai. After they got to the village, Li Li left Shisai with Fu.
Lively Highmountain Salmon Schools can be found in the waters of... in the Broken Isles.
Living Obsidian Legguards drop from Maut in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Lithia Costcutter is a goblin located in Stormsong Valley, operating a shredder. After it is destroyed, she engages her attacker. She is famous for bringing jobs in under budget.
Living Ledger is a flying tome summoned by Auditor Esiel in Suramar.
Living Mountain Shoulderguards drop from Tectus in Highmaul and are looted from Cache of Highmaul Treasures.
Little Lord of Lies is a feat of strength achievement earned by being the owner of the Baal'ial pet.

Locations in World of Warcraft fall under several levels of classification: *Worlds / Planes **Continents ***Zones / Regions ****Subzones / Sub-areas *****Settlements *****Instances To reference a certain location you can use coordinates or a map.
__NOTOC__ Loganaar is a night elf druid trainer and quest giver located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.

Logging out is the process of exiting the game world to the Character select screen. The procedure takes 20 seconds when the toon is not in a major city or an inn. Otherwise, it is instant. It is impossible to logout while in combat. Trying to change armor while Logging out will be unable and the following message will pop up: "You are stunned"

This is a questing guide detailing an efficient method to obtain and complete quests in Loch Modan. For a list of all Loch Modan quests in table format, see Loch Modan quests. Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player an efficient way to complete many quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired).

A location object is a landscape, fixed, or spawned object (possibly mobile as well) that delineates the location of an effect. ;Examples: *Portal *Fishing pool *Instance entrance *Anvil *Moonwell *Mana Loom

:For information about players who pick locks, see Lockpicking. A locksmith is an NPC who restores lost keys that could not otherwise be reacquired, such as those rewarded from quests. City guards will point out the location of locksmiths. During Stay of Execution, Mathias Shaw was surprised to see that the Horde had its improved its locks, wondering if they had learned from the Zandalari locksmiths.

Loggi Grymstone was a cousin of Harkyn Grymstone and said to be located near Aerie Peak in the aftermath of the Third War. A warrior in his own right, Loggi decided not to take up arms against dragons, but instead chose the life of a blacksmith and miner. One day while traveling with a group of miners near the Alterac Mountains he was beset upon by the Scourge. Being stuck in a cave, they were contacted by a certain baron to dig up creatures from ancient times. Loggi, however, got caught shortly after and was presumed dead, until Kalec and his group arrived. He was eventually killed by Dar'Khan Drathir.
Loaned Wind Rider Reins is a special mount that Horde players can obtain from "Honest" Max outside K3 for free, so long as they are at least level 77 and have not purchased Cold Weather Flying.
Lo'Vellian was the twin of Vor'Illian. The pair wielded the magical swords Shalla'tor and Ellemayne during the War of the Ancients.
riding Lockmaw.]] Lockmaw and Augh compose the second boss encounter in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
Lock-On is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Local Pet Mauler is an account-wide Pet battles Battle achievement earned by winning a pet battle in 10 different zones on the Eastern Kingdoms, Kalimdor, Outland, Northrend, or Pandaria continents.
__NOTOC__ Lofty Librams are flying tomes found at the Dalaran Crater in Hillsbrad Foothills. They are also seen in Dazar'alor.
Logic is an ability used by Baby Winston during a pet battle.

__NOTOC__ Locus Researchers are void elves located throughout Telogrus Rift. They are experienced in the ways of void magic, and can be seen conducting numerous experiments into this field around Telogrus.
Lodaeron Sentry Specimen are humans located outside the Old Hillsbrad Foothills in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.

Lloth'wellyn is a sylvar located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. Night Fae Covenant players can run across Lloth'wellyn and help him find his scroll for the island quest Lloth'wellyn's Breakthrough. After looting the scroll, Lloth'wellyn will offer to join Night Fae Covenant-aligned players as an adventuring companion in Champion: Lloth'wellyn.
Livingwood Pommel is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

In tauren mythology, Lo'sho is the personification of the Blue Child, the smaller of Azeroth's two moons. They were born from one of the Earth Mother's tears when the world was young and is the younger sibling of An'she and Mu'sha.

]] The Lodestaff is a Korthian relic, held by the Archivists' Codex. Fueled by anima and guided by wisdom, the Lodestaff will lead its wielder to every relic the archives have ever held. The Maw Walker, alongside Archivist Roh-Senara, puts the Lodestaff back together the invading Mawsworn realize what they possess. Though the archivists normally infuse the lodestaff with energy from :the Netherstar, anima can also be used. The item itself is provided for An Infusion of Anima.

The Locus Shift is a device located on every floor of the Gravid Repose in Zereth Mortis. At the cost of 30 Cosmic Energy, gathered outside in the Resonant Peaks, the device can be used to teleport to other floors of the structure. The option to travel to the various floors are unlocked through the following runes: *Interior Locus Arrangement (Ground floor) *Primus Locus Arrangement (First floor) *Secundus Locus Arrangement (Second floor) *Tertius Locus Arrangement (Third floor) *Quartus Locus Arrangement (Fourth floor) *Quintus Locus Arrangement (Fifth floor) *Ultimus Locus Arrangement (Sixth floor)

The Living Ration is looted from the Eviscerated Argali in the Lost Grotto in the Forbidden Reach. Gorge yourself on the remains to gain Full Belly for 10 minutes, increasing the damage of Fire Breath (evoker ability) by 25%.

Loamm is the main town of the niffen in Zaralek Cavern. Avogadro, the flight master, has connections to Dragonscale Camp and Obsidian Rest. A Dragon Glyph is at near the ceiling above Aurantia. Southeast of the center building at , the Bronze Timekeeper starts the "Zaralek Zigzag" dragonriding race. The town is bordered by Shimmering Towers to the north, Deephollow Lake and the Throughway to the east, the Crystal Fields and Nal ks'kol to the south, and Sulfur Wastes to the west.
Loamm Niffen is the fifth Major Faction of World of Warcraft: Dragonflight.

Longshore is the vast stretch of coastline along Westfall. Traveling along the coast can be tricky as swarms of murlocs roam the beaches unchecked. Longshore is also where night elf druids had to travel to find half of the amulet required to gain their aquatic form at level 16. The other half was in Darkshore on Kalimdor. Old Murk-Eye can be found wandering this coast and offshore there is a wrecked elven destroyer displaying its unicorn symbol. It is one of the biggest beaches on Azeroth. On the far southwestern coast is the farm of Daphne Stilwell, who was attacked by some Defias until promising young Knights of the Silver Hand sent by Duthorian Rall came to repel the attack and protect Da
Lok'amir il Romathis is a epic one-handed mace. It gives bonuses to spirit, intellect, stamina, and spell power.
Look To The Stars sends the adventurer to look for an Engineer in order to get a special item.
__NOTOC__ Lola's Eve is an epic ring for DPS casters - mages, warlocks, shadow priests, balance druids, and elemental shamans. It is part of The Twin Stars set.

s about to attack Kaskala.]] .]] Longships are a type of boat usually used by kvaldir raiders. The kvaldir can be seen using them to attack the tuskarr city of Kaskala. The Naglfar, a fearsome ship, is used to deliver cursed and damned vrykul souls to Helheim and the clutches of Helya. Several other longships are also anchored in Helheim.
Loop of Forged Power is a craftable epic ring for DPS casters.
The Loop of the Kirin Tor is sold by in Dalaran for . It can cost as low as at reputation with Kirin Tor. Using it teleports the adventurer to Dalaran in Northrend.

Lonika's School of Roguery (a.k.a Rogue Academy) is run by Lonika Stillblade. For graduation the rogues receive gloves called Rapscallion's Touch. The school was set up in Shattrath City, but as it's now this crowded by refugees, Lonika searches for a new location. The school is very hard, as the first test kills most students. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Lonika, convinced by Vanessa VanCleef to join the Uncrowned, moved the academy to the Hall of Shadows.
Lon'li Guju is a ghostly flying turtle found on the northeastern shores of Kun-Lai Summit. He responds to friendly emotes, such as /love, /hug, /wave, etc.
Loh-Ki is a pandaren found in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms at the top of a mountain meditating. He tells the legend of Lei Shen's death and the origin of Alani.

Lohrumn Sharphoof was a Highmountain tauren and the brother of Hrul Sharphoof. He was killed during the battles between the tauren and the drogbar, and his armor was taken by the enemy. The adventurers of the Alliance and Horde retrieved his armor and delivered it to his brother.
__NOTOC__ Lohor is a tauren druid and herbalist in :Flight Form located in the Evermorn Springs in Gorgrond, where they are studying the Primal plant life.
Long-Eared Owls are owls found in Highmountain and Stormheim.
Loose Whistlebloom Hives are wasp hives hanging from stone arches in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. Destroying them releases Whistlebloom Drones.
Loose Bilewing Hives are wasp hives hanging from outcroppings around the Four Stingers in Vol'dun. Destroying them releases Bilewing Creepers.
Lokra's Fury is a quest reward from The Strength of Our Bonds.
The Longclaw Fish Catcher is furbolg located on Longclaw Island in the Azure Span. Tullek is teaching them how to fish.

Lore in the Warcraft series of games is a term used for "background story". The use of the term stems from Blizzard's snippets of "lore" for many of the multiplayer maps in their Warcraft RTS games, although how much of it has a relationship to the main Warcraft universe storyline is unclear.
Lordamere Internment Camp was the only internment camp based in the Alterac Mountains. It was located on a hill overlooking the Dalaran Crater, and was defended by Dalaranian forces.

Lord Roccor is a lava elemental mini-boss found in the Halls of the Law inside Blackrock Depths. Before Mists of Pandaria's removal of personal class items, he was notable for dropping a druid idol, as well as the enchanting formula for the Smoking Heart of the Mountain.

Lord Skwol is a hydra boss summoned at a Greater Windstone in Silithus. He is a powerful elemental being requiring 20-40 people to defeat. He is significantly more difficult than the other 3 summoned bosses. Summoning him requires a full Twilight Trappings set, a Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station, and a Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship.

__NOTOC__ Lord Tony Romano is a human senior rogue trainer located in the SI:7 headquarters in Old Town in Stormwind City. He is also found in the Hall of Shadows. He duels with Gregory Charles. When the Uncrowned infiltrated the SI:7 headquarters in order to reveal Detheroc, Tony sneaked up behind Taoshi and attacked her, but she bested him and sapped.

Lord Jorach Ravenholdt is a human rogue located at Ravenholdt Manor in the Alterac Mountains, known to acts as the leader of the Ravenholdt assassin organization. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion on Azeroth, he appeared as the leader of the Uncrowned in the Hall of Shadows in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ Lorelae Wintersong is a night elf trade goods vendor located in Nighthaven in Moonglade.

Lord Aliden Perenolde is a Horde quest in Hillsbrad Foothills and Alterac Mountains that involves killing the leader of the Syndicate, Lord Aliden Perenolde. You must have completed Blackmoore's Legacy before you can get this quest.

Lord Baurles K. Wishock is a human located in Stormwind Keep in the city of Stormwind. He is a member of the influential House of Nobles and can be found in the Petitioner's Chamber, the first room on the left through the keep's main entrance.

Lord Daval Prestor II was the "second" Lord Prestor seen, after Daval Prestor and was located in Stormwind City during the World of Warcraft beta test. However, at some point, he was removed and replaced by Lady Katrana Prestor — the human form of Deathwing's daughter, Onyxia, who took the name Prestor in homage to her father. If Daval Prestor II was intended to be the return of Deathwing himself, a relative of Deathwing such as his son Nefarian, or even another black dragon altogether is unknown. Interestingly enough, the only thing that changed between Daval Prestor II and Katrana Prestor is gender and hair color; the outfit remained the same.

Lordaeron Citizens are invisible wraiths found in the Ruins of Lordaeron of Undercity. They can only be seen by various methods of detecting invisibility, such as the warlock spell Detect Invisibility or the mage spell Invisibility.

The Lords of the Emerald Flame are an incredibly powerful enemy of the worgen. They do battle with the worgen on their native homeworld, and Velinde Starsong got to know of this ferocious war through her use of the Scythe of Elune. Apparently, the struggle against the Lords of the Emerald Flame does not go too well, as the worgen found their enemy to be an unflinching one indeed. :"Holding the Scythe in my hands, I received a vision of chaos. Wolf-men... the worgen... battled an incredible enemy. The worgen fought savagely, as fit their primitive race, but their enemy was unflinching: the Lords of the Emerald Flame." Lord Everblaze is a fire revenant found in southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice in Dragonblight. He is surrounded by many Fiery Dancers. It is high above the ground, near the northern edge of the Path of the Titans. It is only accessible by flying mount.

Lord Marrowgar is the first boss of the Icecrown Citadel raid. Pieced together by the Lich King from the bones of a thousand vanquished adventurers, he is the guardian of the Frozen Throne within The Spire, and wields the power of the throne itself. His weapon is the axe Bryntroll, the Bone Arbiter.

__NOTOC__ Lord Hydronis is a water revenant and servant of Neptulon located on Ranazjar Isle, in Desolace. He has been killing naga, and apparently, he also destroyed the statue of Azshara on Ranazjar Isle. He enlists the aids of adventurers in killing Valishj, since he has become too weary.

__NOTOC__ Lord Fallowmere is a night elf located in Fallowmere Inn of Windshear Hold in the Stonetalon Mountains. He leads Alliance forces at the Hold against the neighboring Horde-controlled Krom'gar Fortress.

Lordaeron Knights are humans who appear in the Culling of Stratholme. They appear outside of Stratholme and like the High Elf Sorceresses they do not assist Arthas during the purge. In The Deaths of Chromie, they are seen with Arthas at the beginning of the city.
Lordaeron Harbor is the harbor of Capital City. It was from here that Arthas Menethil sailed to Northrend in the hunt for Mal'Ganis.

Lord Candren is the quartermaster for Gilneas. He is found in Darnassus's Temple Gardens, near the flight master. Lord Candren survived the Burning of Teldrassil and made his way to Stormwind Embassy.

Lord Ashbury the 1st was a Gilnean noble and the father of Baron Ashbury. Lord Ashbury helped King Archibald Greymane build Gilneas up to a nation of great power. King Archibald always told his son Prince Genn to trust in the Ashburys’ fidelity to the crown because of the accomplishments of Lord Ashbury.

Lord Marley was a Gilnean noble. King Genn Greymane had originally planned to have the Greymane Wall cut through Marley's domain, but later decided to have it cut through Lord Darius Crowley's domain instead at the recommendation of Lord Godfrey. He participated in the secret worgen hunts with King Greymane, Lord Godfrey, Baron Ashbury, and a few other nobles in the Blackwald during full moons. His subsequent fate is unknown.

__NOTOC__ The ghost of Lord Ro'minate stands in the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. He and the others ghosts in the ruins seem to relive moments in their lives. Ro'minate is seen talking to Lady Benel'derath.

__NOTOC__ Lord Hiram Creed was a black drakonid who disguises themselves as an affluent Gilnean noble. __NOTOC__ Lord Oona is a fearsome hozen sea captain and leader of the Oona tribe. He is currently located inside a cavern which they have named Oona Kagu on the northeastern shore of the Jade Forest. He and his crew are a subject of many tales. They are said to have sailed all around the world, defeated kraken, and ventured to a deep underwater kingdom of the naga. Some say there are many Lord Oonas, and that when one dies, another hozen takes his place. In one tale, he drank an elixir of immortality and cannot be killed. In another one, the Oona are all ghosts.

Lord Slitherspear is a naga who serves as the first boss of the Ruined City wing in the League of Explorers adventure of Hearthstone. He has kidnapped Sir Finley Mrrgglton and is planning to cook him in a cauldron.

__NOTOC__ Lord Adder is a nathrezim disguised as a high elf wandering the streets of Dalaran above the Broken Isles. He can be exposed by abilities revealing demons such as by paladins wielding the Truthguard or demon hunters using their Spectral Sight.
Lord Wilson is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Lord Buchanan is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Lord Baker is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity. He is one of the Elite NPCs who can kill a player in a matter of seconds.
Lor'themar's Arrow is a destroyer located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.

Lord Stormsong is the patriarch of House Stormsong. He claims that he seeks to take control of the shattered Kul Tiras and restore it to its former glory, seeing the elite of Boralus as haughty folk who give nothing in return for his people's work. In his eyes, Kul Tiras will forever belong to the people and the Tidesages will guide them. However the truth is that Lord Stormsong has recently fallen under the sway of Queen Azshara and her masters. He was a very kind person before the whispers took him. He is a boss in the Shrine of the Storm dungeon. He becomes a k'thir before the battle.

__NOTOC__ Lor'danel Sentinels are night elves located in Lor'danel, the Ruins of Mathystra, and Shatterspear Vale in Darkshore. During the War of the Thorns, they protected the village and night elven army.

Lord Gazzran is a flamewaker located in the Blazing Cavern accessed during Island Expeditions.
Lordaeron Footman Specimens are humans located outside the Culling of Stratholme in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Lordaeron Watchman Specimens are humans located outside the Old Hillsbrad Foothills in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Lordaeron Knight Specimens are humans who were located outside the Culling of Stratholme in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.

Lordaeron Sentry Specimens are humans located outside the Old Hillsbrad Foothills in the Caverns of Time. They are Lordaeron Sentries that have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.

Protected by mountains on three sides, Lost Rigger Cove is the hideout port of the Southsea Pirates on the coast of Tanaris. It notably contains a shipyard where a new vessel is being built. Fighting to make a deal with the baron of Gadgetzan, the gnome and goblin speakers have set up camp just outside the main area and have begun attacking and killing off the pirates.

The Lost Thunderbrew Recipe shows how to brew Thunderbrew Lager, an ale created by Ragnar Thunderbrew which is reported to give the inbiber great strength. The recipe was stolen by Hurley Blackbreath of the Dark Iron dwarves.

The Lost Fold is a site where broken cages and debris as well as the many crystals from the crashing Exodar has landed, on Bloodmyst Isle similar to the Menagerie Wreckage on Azuremyst Isle. It contains numerous wandering ravagers and is located just north of Kessel's Crossing. The crystals landed have not yet corrupted this part of the island.
__NOTOC__ Lothros, Servant of Illidan, is an Illidari nathrezim found wandering around Illidari Point in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Lorrin Foxfire is a blood elf portal trainer located in Stonard, Swamp of Sorrows. He teaches mages of level 35 and up Teleport: Stonard and Portal: Stonard.
"Losses of the Third War" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.

__NOTOC__ Loremaster Skosiris is a blood elf found at the Seer's Library on Scryer's Tier in Shattrath City. He guards a vast collection of book closets, which serve as master trainers for all the professions currently available to World of Warcraft players.

Lorna Crowley is the daughter of Lord Darius Crowley, one of the principal leaders during the Northgate Rebellion. After the retaking of Gilneas City, she joined her father as commander of the Gilneas Liberation Front. When the Burning Legion returned to assault Azeroth, Lorna and Darius joined Genn Greymane on the Skyfire as part of his army forces.

__NOTOC__ Loren the Fence is the rogue trainer seen in Gilneas City and Gilneas. Following the conclusion of the worgen starting experience, she can be found inside the Howling Oak of Darnassus, where she continues to serve as a rogue trainer. She is also found in the Hall of Shadows.

Lormic Farroden was an elite level 85 Battle for Gilneas battlemaster located in Stormwind City during the Call to Arms: Battle for Gilneas. He was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Battle for Gilneas).

Lorenth Thundercall is one of the Shatterspear tribe's sub-leaders in Darkshore, where he can be found standing on top of a large tree stump near the Tower of Althalaxx, out of combat range.

Lorewalker Stonestep is the narrator of the second boss of the Temple of the Jade Serpent. The encounter automatically starts after destroying the Corrupted Scroll. After its destruction, it will randomly select between the two possible stories.

Loric Fielding is a human located at the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.

Lotharian Peacekeepers are draenei peacekeepers who briefly appeared in the Warlords of Draenor alpha stage during the battle. Furious Lotharian Peacekeepers, probably the upgraded defending version, were also planned to appear. It seems they were intended to be linked to the Sons of Lothar, but like with other lore bloopers of the alpha (example being the presence of the Stormreaver clan) they were eventually cut before the release.

Lorna Stoutfoot is a dwarven quest giver and member of Hemet's Hunting Party found at Icepine Point in Highmountain. She disapproves of Razik Gazbolt's methods, saying that a true hunter relies on instinct, skill, and agility rather than mechanical contraptions.

Loren Stormhoof is a Highmountain tauren hunter of the Skyhorn tribe where he acts as an emissary to the Unseen Path. He becomes a champion of the Huntmaster. His knowledge of the flora and fauna of the Broken Isles is unsurpassed and he is skilled in identifying them. He accompanies Emmarel Shadewarden into the Exodar and participates in the fight against High General Rakeesh.
Lorin is a nightborne located at the Evermoon Commons in Suramar. He helps kill Overseer Durant during Make Your Mark.

The Lost Glacier is an ancient drifting glacier located near a small island north of Northrend. It contains the remains of a red dragon named Kyranastrasz as well as a large number of feral undead. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, the Deathlord of the Knights of the Ebon Blade was sent there by the Lich King in order to revive the skeletal dragon as their new mount.
Lost Explorer's Bounty is located inside a small cave on the northern slopes of a mountain in southeastern Vol'dun, next to a broken wagon and two Zandalari skeletons.

The Lost Cat Toy is found in a room in Suramar locked off with four beams of light. Interacting with it, will teleport the adventurer outside and give them a random 5-digit damage number. This number will server as the code for that team in the next step of the riddle.

Lost Sailors are human ghosts who first appear at the Crescent Cove in Stormsong Valley during Opening the Way. Another one appears at Fate's End as the only inhabitant of the island and will send adventurers back to Stormsong if asked.

Lua (from the Portuguese word for moon) is the scripting language used by World of Warcraft for Interface Customization. Only a subset of version 5.1 of the official Lua specification is implemented, and should suit most addon maker's needs. More information about Lua can be found on the official Lua [http://lua-users.org/wiki/LuaFaq FAQ].
Lucius is a dwarf located on the Lakeshire docks in the Redridge Mountains. He once taught young rogues how to lockpick. He is an associate of SI:7.
Lucius's Lockbox is located in Alther's Mill of the Redridge Mountains. It requires a lockpicking skill of 25.

.]] Lumber (or wood and timber) is a resource that is harvested by lumberjacks and is generally taken to be processed in a lumber mill. Lumber is one of the main resources that is used in the Warcraft RTS games. It is harvested by worker units from nearby trees and forests. In Outland and in certain underground maps, lumber can be harvested from large mushrooms. Wood warped by foul demonic magic is of no use to builders, and nothing sound can be built with it, but ancients can purify it for use.

Lovely Charm Bracelet is made by combining 10 Lovely Charm. The Lovely Charms has a chance to be obtained when you kill an enemy that yields XP or Honor while you have a Lovely Charm Collector's Kit in your bags. You do not have a higher chance to gain Lovely Charms if the enemy is more level-appropriate. The Collector's Kit is obtained from Kwee Q. Peddlefeet in any major city. (See the Lovely Charms page for full details on acquiring them.) Note that while Lovely Charms and Love Tokens are BoP, this item can be traded. You may exchange 1 Lovely Charm Bracelet for 1 Love Token from any Lovely Merchant.
Lovely Charm Collector's Kit is obtained from Kwee Q. Peddlefeet in any Azerothian capital city.
The Lovely Undercity Card is a quest reward from A Gift for the Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas. It grants the Lovely Card intellect buff.

Lovely Card is a 1-hour buff to a specific stat, gained by using one of: These buffs are mutually exclusive; using any of these cards will cancel the old buff before starting the new one. These buffs do stack with scrolls, potions, and spells (such as Arcane Intellect and Power Word: Fortitude).
Luknar is a Broken shaman trainer located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
Lucian Fenner is a Forsaken located in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
Lower City Healers are humans, orcs, and sporelings located inside the Shadow Labyrinth.
Lower City Operatives are orcs, humans, and Broken located inside Shadow Labyrinth.
Lucky Dance is an ability used by murlocs during a Pet Battle.
Love Potion is an ability used by Peddlefeet during a Pet Battle.
Lovestruck is an ability used by Peddlefeet during a Pet Battle.
Lullaby was one of the pet abilities that only cranes could use.

Lowping is a gnome located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. He also appears as a prisoner from the naga in Oceanus Cove in Azsuna. He is a friend of Fargo Flintlocke and has his schematics tattooed on top of his head. Fargo sends adventurers of the Alliance and Horde to find Lowping but instead of rescuing, the hero shaved Lowping's head and copied the schematics.
Lower Gardens is the gardens at Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.

Lucas Sigmund is a human repair vendor found at Nesingwary's Retreat in Highmountain. His father served King Llane Wrynn during the First War, before Garona Halforcen took his life. He remarks that if he ever meets her, he will strangle her himself.
Luggut the Eggeater is a worm vignette found in the Rockcrawler Chasm in Highmountain.

Lozar is an imp who escaped from imprisonment in a Soul Chamber and can now be found wandering around the southwesternmost corner of the Mucksnout Den in Highmountain. He is one of several demons which Apprentice Rosalyn asks adventurers to help her contain once again.

.]] Lucille "Lucy" Waycrest is the daughter of Arthur and Meredith of House Waycrest, making her the heir to one of the most powerful houses of Kul Tiras. She plays a significant role in combating the drust incursion in Drustvar.
Lugo the Windrider is the flight master for Vorrik's Sanctum in Vol'dun. He is technically not located in the sanctum subzone itself, but rather on the Conqueror's Path just outside it.
Loz the Paku'ai is a Zandalari troll flight master located in Zuldazar.
Lumbering Gatecrasher is a mo'arg brute who would appear in Suramar City.
Lu'si is a mogu ghost who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Luka Morespark is a Mechagon mechagnome located in Mechagon City.
Lumbering Charge is an ability used by various beast pets during a Pet Battle.
Lovingly Worn Wrenches are looted from Mechanized Chests and Mechanized Supply Chests on Mechagon Island.
Lumbering Nightmares are abominations located in the Emerald Dream version of Gilneas City during A Gilnean's Dream.
The Lovestruck Citizens are two draenei located in Shattrath City Center in Talador.

Lucky Horace is a Forsaken located underneath Lucky Horace's Lucky Chest at Naz'agal in Nazmir. It seems the chest along with its owner fell from the nearby beached destroyer.
Lumbering Form is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Luffa-Infused Embrace is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Luffa-Infused Embrace.
